WITH status_tallies AS (
  SELECT archstat, COUNT(*) AS tally
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
), shares AS (
  SELECT archstat, tally, tally::numeric / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_tallies
), average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT s.archstat AS status,
       s.tally,
       s.share,
       s.share - a.avg_share AS above_average
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;
